summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #583, specifically a greptile-flagged bug where publishNodeFn ignores the success flag returned by createAndPublishIpnsRecord.
summary.outcome: Fixed the bug in client.ts where the publishNodeFn closure discarded the success boolean from createAndPublishIpnsRecord, matching the guard pattern already used in rotateWriteSubtree. All 210 unit tests passed and the fix was committed and pushed.

repo: rotateWriteSubtree at line 1405 of sdk/src/client.ts guards publishResult.success, but the publishNodeFn closure at line 1763 previously ignored it — inconsistent error handling within the same file.
createAndPublishIpnsRecord returns { success: boolean; sequenceNumber: bigint } — callers must check success explicitly.
Live-API integration test suites are excluded from regular local test runs; 210 non-integration tests pass cleanly.

code.finding: publishNodeFn closure was not checking publishResult.success, unlike the sibling rotateWriteSubtree at line 1405 which does guard it.
rotateWriteSubtree guards publishResult.success — this is the correct pattern to replicate elsewhere.

workflow: GraphQL reviewThreads query is needed to fetch PR threads with isResolved status; REST API does not expose this field.
gh api REST comment replies require --field (integer) for in_reply_to, not -f.
